resources.string: Daily monitoring and longer-term local trends.
Explore your local stress estimate, daily timeline and breathing tools.
%1$d of 5 have a trusted baseline comparison
Personal ranges use the local rolling baseline after 14 valid nights. Missing or unverified readings do not count as within range. Tap a metric to review its trend.
Personal range is not ready: %1$d valid nights. At least 14 nights and recent overnight wear are needed.
This reading is not verified and is not used for personal-range assessment.
No verified HRV for this day. Overnight coverage may be incomplete.
No resting heart-rate reading for this day.
No overnight respiratory-rate reading for this day.
Calibrated blood oxygen requires imported data. Raw optical values are not a blood-oxygen percentage.
No skin-temperature reading for this day. Overnight wear or an import is needed.
Separate from overnight metrics. This view shows received readings; open Live HR to start streaming. A reading timestamp is not available here.
Device disconnected. Open Live HR after reconnecting.
Local wellness observations, not a diagnosis. These ranges and estimates are not medical measurements.
A local PDF with mean, minimum, maximum and valid-day counts for the five overnight metrics. Share it with the system sheet.
Temperature summary uses absolute skin temperature only.
Temperature summary uses deviation from baseline only; absolute readings are excluded.
Source: resolved daily records stored on this device. Individual input sources are not retained in this summary. No server is contacted to generate it.
Missing and nonfinite values are excluded, never treated as zero. Experimental blood-oxygen estimates and HRV nights flagged for R-R over-count are excluded.
Could not create or share the Health Report.
Optional, on-device notifications when multiple overnight signals change together after a trusted baseline. An isolated outlier does not trigger an alert. System notification permission is required.
%1$d of 14 recorded recovery days. Keep collecting overnight data to unlock a report.
Explore long-term health estimates from your local history.
